jobs.label: 새싹콩
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE actual source character key drawing for a 2D game combat-attribute pair, not a mockup or animation preview.
Input image: supporting species identity, materials, palette and approved single-attribute reference. It is a six-cell reference atlas, NOT the output layout.
Primary request: Design the EXACT TWO selected attributes so their structures FIT TOGETHER as one coherent organism. Preserve the recognizable single-attribute design language. Adjust proportions, shared roots, continuous surfaces, intersections and silhouette together. The two functions must be visually readable within the SAME anatomical/material construction.
Output: Exactly ONE complete character, ONE neutral ready pose, mostly front view with a slight rightward orientation. Centered full body, feet baseline when species has feet. Entire silhouette inside a square canvas with 10% clear padding. Large subject but no edge touching. Real transparent background.
Style: match the approved small game sprites: charming simple readable forms, subtly hand-painted soft shading, crisp dark thin contours, consistent upper-left lighting, broad calm surfaces, restrained details. Exactly two eyes, no mouth. No cast shadow, labels, lettering, ground, effects, detached particles, extra characters or diagrams.
Do not mechanically stack the two single-attribute drawings. Design their shared connection cleanly. Avoid adding any UNSELECTED attribute; this is a two-attribute combination, not a complete five-attribute evolution. No manufactured weapons, handles, belts, armor worn as clothes, floating equipment, horror, gritty realism, 3D toy render, pixel art, gradient backdrop or decorative sparkle.
Draw complete clean surfaces and smooth closed outlines. This actual neutral drawing may later be used for rigging only after user approval.

SPECIES: A pale cream-green plump round sprout bean with exactly TWO dark green bead eyes, no mouth, two tiny pale feet, and green leaves rooted in one living crown. Match the reference body proportions and simple soft painterly shading. The reference atlas cells are row1 base / blade / piercing, row2 carapace / guard / secretion. Guard also has exactly two eyes; never extra dots next to eyes.
SELECTED ATTRIBUTES ONLY: blade + secretion (칼날 + 분비).
INTEGRATED CONSTRUCTION: A pair of smooth scythe-edged green leaves grows from the crown (blade). Two tiny swollen nectar glands are continuous thickened portions of these same leaf midribs, with warm amber beads at the margin (secretion). No separate bouquet, no buds on extra stalks.
